content:
anna (partnerships): Quick share: BlueHarbor signed an expanded ISV agreement to list Redwood Dedicated on AWS Marketplace. Expansion includes a managed deployment offer and a 2yr renewal option. :rocket:

 david (sales): This is great news — expansion upsell from their pilot. Deal structure: 18mo Dedicated commitment + marketplace managed plan. ARR impact ~330k.

 leila (marketing): Nice. I'll prep a partner spotlight and a short customer quote request. Can someone confirm the customer contact for the quote?

 anna (partnerships): I'm connecting you to their Head of Ops (cc'ed in the kickoff invite). They agreed to a 3-paragraph case study and a short testimonial.

 harry (eng): Heads up — BlueHarbor asked for SAML SSO and cross-account infra templates for AWS. Also want a custom AMI for their regulated env. We should scope infra tasks.

 nina (security): Also requested SOC2 attestation and enhanced audit logging. We'll need to provide an artifact pack and KMS key management notes. I'll coordinate with compliance.

 marketplace-bot: marketplace-bot: Created AWS listing ticket AWS-3302 and linked marketplace onboarding doc: https://confluence.internal/redwood/marketplace/aws-onboarding.

 david (sales): @harry @nina can you estimate the lift for SSO + AMI + audit artifacts? Need a rough timeline to commit to BlueHarbor.

 harry (eng): Rough estimate: SAML SSO integration + docs = 2 weeks, AMI build + hardened image = 3 weeks, audit artifacts collection = 1 week. Some parallel work possible.

 nina (security): I'll start the SOC2 artifact gather this week. If they need additional controls, we'll flag it.

 leila (marketing): Plan: draft partner spotlight, landing page blurb, and a banner for the Marketplace tile. Will request a 25-40 word customer quote and logo files.

 anna (partnerships): Legal is looping in for the marketplace terms. Also negotiated a joint webinar option for Q2. Putting the kickoff for next Wed on calendar.

 david (sales): Solid. I'll confirm timelines with BlueHarbor and push for the testimonial after their POC wrap. Great team — let's aim for Marketplace listing in 4 weeks. :tada:
